That assumes roughly 150 g of noodles (about 200 kcal), about 80 g of beef with sauce and oil (about 180 kcal), and vegetables (about 20 kcal).

The photo was taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed a small amount, about 40 kcal, which gives about 360 kcal eaten.
